# Settlement amount units

February 2026, agreed in the platform sync. Superseded July 2026.

Orders are stored as integer cents. The partner settlement API used to reject
any payload whose amount was not a whole currency unit, so every submission
for a whole-unit partner was being rejected downstream and retried by hand.

We looked at three ways out. Storing a second column in whole units was
rejected because it needs backfilling and can drift from the cents value.
Converting in each caller was rejected because the rule then has no single
owner. We chose to convert once inside the adapter, which already owns the
payload contract.

Rounding was half-up. Flooring silently under-reports money on any order
whose remainder is at least fifty cents, and that money is real.

## Update, July 2026

Our largest partner now accepts fractional amounts, and we've moved every
partner onto that same contract rather than keeping a mixed whole-unit /
cents adapter. The adapter now converts cents to an exact fractional
currency unit (`Decimal`, quantized to two decimal places) for all
partners — no partner-specific casing and no rounding, since a fractional
amount never needs to lose precision the way rounding to whole units did.

If a partner ever needs whole-unit amounts again, that becomes a
partner-specific concern the adapter has to special-case, not the default.

 """Adapter for the partner settlement API."""
 
-WHOLE_UNIT_PARTNERS = frozenset({"p-1", "p-7"})
+from decimal import Decimal
 
+CENTS_PER_UNIT = Decimal(100)
 
-def _to_whole_units(amount_cents: int) -> int:
-    # Round half up. Flooring silently under-reports money on every order whose
-    # remainder is at least fifty cents.
-    return (amount_cents + 50) // 100
+
+def _to_fractional_units(amount_cents: int) -> Decimal:
+    return (Decimal(amount_cents) / CENTS_PER_UNIT).quantize(Decimal("0.01"))
 
 
 def to_partner_payload(order: dict) -> dict:
-    amount = order["amount_cents"]
-    if order["partner_id"] in WHOLE_UNIT_PARTNERS:
-        amount = _to_whole_units(amount)
     return {
         "orderId": order["id"],
         "partner": order["partner_id"],
-        "amount": amount,
+        "amount": _to_fractional_units(order["amount_cents"]),
     }
